hook.name: LiberSlethHook
hook.description: A custom-curve no-liquidity hook for a LETH/SLETH pool on Arbitrum. Buys (LETH→SLETH) forward the swapper's LETH minus fee to the SLETH contract's canonical mint function; sells (SLETH→LETH) pay from an owner-funded LETH reserve and send SLETH to a burn address. Liquidity addition is blocked and the AMM curve is bypassed entirely via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Includes per-epoch mint/redemption caps and a pausable owner switch.
